notes: The rate page index_hendo_shushin_choice_20_6 publishes three rate tables: 死亡保障プラン (param hendo_shushin_choice_20_6), 認知症・介護プラン(告知あり) (_1) and 認知症・介護プラン(告知なし) (_2), in the page's own order; the mapping of plan to param is confirmed by the title of each saved history page (e.g. history_hendo_shushin_choice_20_6_1 is headed （認知症・介護プラン （告知あり））).

Guarantee periods (term_years) differ by currency: USD 10, 30; AUD 10, 20; JPY 15, 30 (rate page and history tables of 2026-11-17). There is no 5-year guarantee period; 5年 in the 死亡保障プラン table is the 保障抑制期間. The dementia/care plans offer only AUD 20 for AUD.
Not collected: the 高額優遇利率 (higher rate for premiums of 50M JPY / 400k USD / 500k AUD or more) linked from the rate page.

All names listed under editions share this policy form and the same rate page (index_hendo_shushin_choice_20_6) on the insurer's rate hub. 227 (家族を想う認知症保険３) is listed on the hub under the same rate page and is recorded as an edition although it is dementia-oriented.
Product type whole_life_rate_locked is provisional; the dementia/care plans may be borderline products and were not read in a brochure.

The distributors list is the 銀行・信用金庫・信用組合・証券 section of the product page (for 224 it covers every plan); the 乗合代理店 (independent agencies) list is not recorded. Edition distributors are given on each edition.

For the 死亡保障プラン crediting-rate table the history has a third header row, 保障抑制期間 (death-benefit suppression period) of 9 months or 5 years; it is part of the plan key (plans shibo_holdback_9m and shibo_holdback_5y, plan_base shibo; until 2026-11-17 it was stored in age_band as supp9m / supp5y). The MVA table has no such row, so its plan stays shibo. The rate page also splits the plan by issue age (death-protection plan: USD ages 20-80 take 30 years and 81-90 take 10; AUD 20-85 take 20 and 86-90 take 10; JPY 20-80 take 30 and 81-90 take 15; dementia/care plans: USD 40-80 / 81-85, AUD 40-85, JPY 40-80 / 81-85), which the history table encodes through the guarantee term only. The two dementia/care plans have no suppression-period row.

Launch date not established (left null). The insurer's news releases give 『プレミアプレゼント2』 on sale from 2020-07 (month only, in the text of release id=1014; the 2020 release itself is not in the release index), 『プレミアプレゼント３』 from 2022-08-01 (id=1014, 2022-07-28) and 『プレミアプレゼント４』 from 2024-10-01 (id=1047, 2024-09-27). No release announces 『プレミアプレゼント５』 or gives a day for the first edition of the formal 積立利率変動型終身保険（20）. Release index 2008-2026 read 2026-11-17; snapshots sources/dfl/pages/release_1014_2026-11-17.pdf, release_1047_2026-11-17.pdf.

Launch date search 2026-11-17 (second pass): DFL release lists 2025-2026 (ids 1052-1084) and the bodies of saved release PDFs; two web searches for プレミアプレゼント５ 取扱開始. No release or bank notice found; current brochures are April 2026 editions and give no launch month. Still null.
notes_en: Rate history starts on 1 December 2025 and covers three plans: death protection, and dementia and care with or without a health declaration.
Guarantee periods differ by currency: 10 and 30 years for USD, 10 and 20 for AUD, 15 and 30 for JPY.
The 9 months or 5 years shown on the death protection plan is a period in which the death benefit is held back, not a guarantee period; it is shown in the plan name.
Higher rates for very large premiums are not collected.
The dementia and care plans have not been checked against a brochure, so the product classification is provisional. Launch date not established.

verification.method: An independent parser (scripts/recheck_candidates_a.py, not the collector's) compared 93 rows with their saved snapshots and all matched: a seeded random sample of 93 of 912 published rows (10% of each rate CSV, at least 20), every outlier (0: a value more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, a move of more than 1pp between consecutive periods, or a value outside 0-15%; 10pp and 0-300% for participation rates) and every not_offered row (0). A follow-up pass over every row also matched.
verification.note: Rows with a retrieved_date after verified_through have not been re-checked.
